scope: Own-year disclosed supplier cohort plus a separately dated contemporary geographic backbone; all shipment and access routes are inferred.
cohortBasis: Supplier lists were published retrospectively. The two 2011 events use the approved January 2012 names-only roster approximation, with missing manufacturing geography. Financial attributes are publication-filtered; this is a retrospective backtest, not a real-time reconstruction.
supplyDefinition: Product-family compatibility inferred from first-hand device teardowns, not a current Apple bill of materials or evidence of a supplier-to-plant purchase order. Unrecognized categories are left unlinked. No tier-2 links are asserted without named public buyer evidence; current unsourced model classifications and post-event assembly evidence are excluded from model hops.

backbone.scope: Contemporary geographic reference, not an own-year supplier roster or evidence of historical Apple shipments. No backbone node or route enters model features or outcome labels.
backbone.routeDefinition: Inferred schematic connection from public geography and transport corridors; no Apple shipment, volume, schedule, capacity or allocation is disclosed.
backbone.nearestGatewayDefinition: Minimum haversine distance among the curated backbone port and airport nodes, using each supplier's disclosed city/province/country reference; not the nearest of every gateway worldwide or a verified driving route

mineralReference.scope: Contemporary mineral context, separate from historical supplier cohorts and model inputs. Mining nodes describe source regions, never specific mines or verified Apple origins. All commodity-compatible supply and transport links are inferred; recycling, purchases, allocations and actual shipment paths remain unknown.

sourceChoice.basis: The 2026 Form SD explicitly does not file a CMR. The latest CMR (2024, filed 2025) contains a country-of-origin table and refers to a separate facility list. Facility names are therefore parsed from the current Apple-published 2026 materials annex, not invented or misattributed to the SEC exhibit. The older static Apple-Smelter-and-Refiner-List.pdf covers 2022 and is not used.

originPolicy.basis: Apple states that it notified suppliers to cease direct or indirect sourcing of 3TG for Apple parts/products from DRC and Rwanda. Regional mineral-compatibility edges are global context only and must explicitly retain this restriction; they are not current Apple sourcing assertions. Refinery location alone does not identify the origin of its feedstock.
